row.evidence: Zuora publishes no pricing (sales is a 'Talk to an expert' request form), and its OneID docs describe enabling provisioning using the SCIM API from Okta and Microsoft Entra ID.
row.notes: Quote-only: Zuora publishes no plans or prices (zuora.com/pricing redirects to a product page; sales is a 'Talk to an expert' form) and documents SCIM, so under rule 6a the row is gated at low confidence; which contracts include OneID SCIM is not public. New row. SCIM 2.0 runs through Zuora OneID (one.zuora.com/scim/v2), which Zuora Global Support must activate; it needs a working custom SAML app and an OAuth 2.0 client (authorization code for Okta, client credentials for Entra). Okta: create, update, deactivate, push groups. Entra: users and groups, with the ?aadOptscim062020 flag required. The Okta OIN 'Zuora' app is SSO only; Entra has no gallery app; Google and JumpCloud are SAML only.

auth.token_source: OneID portal > avatar > Settings > Manage OAuth 2.0 Clients > New (Authorization Code with type 'SCIM Client (IdP)' for Okta; Client Credentials for Entra and server-to-server)
auth.token_expiry: Short-lived OAuth access tokens; client secret shown once

deprovision.notes: Okta's Deactivate Users is enabled; a deactivated OneID user cannot sign in through the portal or SSO.

limitations.text: Entra must append ?aadOptscim062020 to the Tenant URL; legacy-format PATCH requests are rejected and on-demand group membership updates fail.
Group membership only applies to users that already exist in Zuora.
OneID must first be activated through Zuora Global Support.

scim.notes: SCIM provisions into Zuora OneID, the identity layer for Zuora tenants (Billing, Revenue, Zephr and others). Okta and Entra both use custom SAML apps, not catalogue apps.

user_api.notes: OneID's documented user management APIs are SCIM 2.0-based (recorded under scim). The 'OneID API reference' they link to was not found on developer.zuora.com (its llms.txt lists no OneID or user endpoints), so no non-SCIM user API is recorded.

okta.notes: The OIN 'Zuora' app ticks SAML and SWA only. Zuora's OneID SCIM guide uses a custom app (Create App Integration > SAML 2.0) with SCIM provisioning added.

entra.notes: Not in the Entra gallery; custom (non-gallery) SAML app with automatic provisioning.

google.notes: Custom SAML app; no Google provisioning documented.
